rag.text:
Test: TC-5145 — Timebox schedule - Editing parameters of timebox schedule in sidebar
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-503 Timebox Schedule
Labels: Sanity

Steps:
1. Navigate to App Settings → Timebox schedules.

Create new timebox schedule providing data:

* Name: name
* Timebox levels: timeboxLevels
* Start date: startDate
* Connect Global Teams: globalTeam
   Data: * name: TC-5145 Schedule
* timeboxLevels: Program Increment, Iteration
* startDate: 01/Jan/25
* globalTeam:  TC-5145 Team 1
   Expected: Timebox schedule is created successfully.

User navigates to timebox schedule details page.

Sidebar is opened.

Schedule structure tab is selected.
2. Click on Name field.

Remove text and click besides the field.
   Expected: Red border is displaying for Name field.

In the right bottom corner there is red exclamation mark with tooltip:

This field cannot be empty
3. Provide text in Name field and click besides it.

In the right bottom corner there is red exclamation mark with tooltip:

text is correctly displayed in Description field.
8. Click on right bottom corner of the Description field and drag down to enlarge the field.
   Expected: Height of description field is increased.
9. Hover over Timebox levels field.

Click on X button next to timeboxName.
